name: Agent CLIs (codex, opencode)
description: Puts `codex` and `opencode` on PATH. Neither is authenticated here — credentials are a runtime concern and baking them in would leak them into a layer.

codexVersion.description: @openai/codex version. Keep in step with the version resolved in pnpm-lock.yaml so a session invoking `codex` gets the CLI Cyrus itself drives.
